perks.name: Pleas Heard
perks.description: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
perks.exact:
Upon finishing an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm reload within 3 seconds of a kill:
Restores 2HP/s until firing any weapon, casting Grenade, Melee, Class, or Super Ability, or upon taking damage from an enemy. 

Can be triggered multiple times from a single kill if another reload is performed within the time window.
Receiving Environmental Damage, or dealing damage through other means does not stop the health regen.

perks.name: Magnificent Duty
perks.description: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health or healing an ally at Critical Health:

For Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms:
+20 Range, +20 Stability, +30 Reload Speed, and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for 11 seconds.

Using a Support Frame Auto to heal a Critical Health Ally after triggering the Pleas Heard effect removes the healing effect as it requires firing to heal... Bungie?
